annotations.title: Send a pitch to Mode VC

description: Sends a founder's pitch to the Mode VC team (pre-seed and seed AI companies, checks of US$1M to 5M; see get_mode_vc_thesis_and_criteria). This tool shares data: the founder name, email, company, one-line pitch, stage and deck link go to Mode VC. Show the founder exactly what will be sent and set consent to true only after they agree. Set office_hours to true to also ask for a 20-minute call. Same intake as the form at https://modevc.com/contact. Nothing is shared with anyone outside Mode VC.

consent.description: Must be true: the founder has seen these details and agreed to send them to Mode VC.

deck_url.description: Optional link to the deck (http or https).

email.description: Email the founder wants Mode VC to reply to.

office_hours.description: True to ask for a 20-minute office hours call.

one_liner.description: One sentence on what the company does and for whom (up to 300 characters).

name: apply_to_mode_vc
